title: Ethics for AI — MCP Server
description: Run the Ethics for AI MCP server. Connect any MCP client to the Actor’s /mcp endpoint. Tool calls are metered pay-per-event; no monthly fee. This server is read-only and takes no input.

maxTotalChargeUsd.title: Maximum total charge (USD)
maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap on how much a run may charge. Recommended when letting an autonomous agent call the server. Example: 0.10 USD ≈ 5 tool calls.
